tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (8.6:1).

tokens.name: cream-white
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.btn-primary`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: taupe-mid
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-change`, `.status-confirmed`, `.footer-meta`. 2.7:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Used as text on `body`, `.logo`, `.nav a:hover, .nav a.active`. 13.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: charcoal-light
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.nav a`, `.btn-secondary`. 5.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: soft-gold
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo:hover`, `.card-badge`, `.section-link:hover`. 2.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: zen-stone
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.section-link`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
